title: allocasuarina helmsii
intro: Allocasuarina helmsii, commonly known as the Black Sheoak, is a species of tree in the family Cephalotaceae. It is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The Black Sheoak has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and may have anti-cancer effects. The bioactive constituents of Allocasuarina helmsii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
